answer: Proof of Burn acts as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to destroy native tokens to earn weight, creating a ripple effect that aligns economic incentives with protocol longevity. Unlike ferrous hardware-based proof-of-work, this method forces a measurable cost on attackers who must sacrifice capital for every fake identity. While a poem or sonnet can be generated for free, the burn cost ensures that creating a million identities becomes computationally and financially prohibitively expensive.
